item.command: /bin/bash -lc "npm run build && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\"; import vm from \"node:vm\"; const html=readFileSync(\"ui/index.html\",\"utf8\"); const script=html.match(/<script>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/script>/)[1]; new vm.Script(script); console.log(\"UI script syntax OK\");' && DATABASE_PATH=/tmp/job-tracker-recovery.db node --input-type=module -e 'import {DatabaseSync} from \"node:sqlite\"; import {spawn} from \"node:child_process\"; import {setTimeout as sleep} from \"node:timers/promises\"; const path=\"/tmp/job-tracker-recovery.db\"; const db=new DatabaseSync(path); db.exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL\"); db.exec("'`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT,input TEXT,steps INTEGER,fail_attempts INTEGER,attempts INTEGER,progress_completed INTEGER,result_output TEXT,error TEXT,created_at TEXT,updated_at TEXT,available_at INTEGER DEFAULT 0); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload TEXT,job_id TEXT); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS worker_state(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,heartbeat INTEGER); DELETE FROM jobs;`); db.prepare("INSERT INTO jobs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)").run("interrupted","running","hello",1,3,3,0,null,null,new Date().toISOString(),new Date().toISOString(),0); db.close(); const child=spawn("node",["--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning","dist/worker.js"],{env:{...process.env,DATABASE_PATH:path},stdio:"ignore"}); await sleep(500); const check=new DatabaseSync(path); const row=check.prepare("SELECT status,attempts,error FROM jobs WHERE id=?").get("interrupted"); child.kill("SIGTERM"); console.log(JSON.stringify(row)); if(row.status!=="failed"||row.attempts!==3||row.error!=="transient failure") process.exitCode=1; check.close();'"'"

item.text:
Addressed all four findings: fixed the UI script and disabled native form validation, made interrupted third failures terminal during recovery, and captured the new job response before the worker can claim it.

`npm run build`, the UI script syntax check, and a recovery check passed. I couldn’t verify HTTP startup here because the environment rejects local socket binding with `EPERM`.
